title: Team configuration v1
description: A proposed agent team: who builds, who reviews, where each member executes and under which model, tool, data and budget limits. team_configure only stores it as a paused, signed proposal; nothing runs from it until a person approves that exact digest. control/team.mjs validateTeam enforces the cross-field rules listed in each description, which plain JSON Schema cannot express. There is deliberately no money budget: spend is bounded only by the turn, token and time budgets the runtime can actually count.

execution_policy.description: native_only: every member is native. api_only: every member is managed_api, and no agent CLI is ever started. hybrid: any mix.

members.description: Member ids are unique. At least one builder and one reviewer. Only a builder may hold write_file or write_paths.

provider.description: native requires host; cli requires openai or anthropic; managed_api requires openai, anthropic, local or mock.

allowed_resolved_models.description: Exact model names the provider may report back instead of requested_model (for example a dated snapshot of an alias). Any other reported model, or none, stops the node: there is no silent fallback.

write_paths.description: Must be empty unless tool_scope holds write_file, which only a builder may.

credential_env.description: The NAME of the environment variable that holds the API key. Never the key itself. Required for managed_api with openai or anthropic, forbidden for native and cli.

endpoint.description: managed_api only. https URL, or http on a loopback address. Required for local and mock; openai and anthropic default to their public API base.

budget.description: Required for managed_api, forbidden elsewhere (the runtime could not count it).
